clue1: It's just a big ditch. I could dig this in my backyard if I had a free weekend and a decent shovel.
clue2: The river at the bottom is practically invisible. Totally overhyped, dusty Arizona tourist trap.
clue3: Tried to use it to color in my coloring book, but it was too heavy and ruined the paper.
clue4: The most famous wax-based writing utensil in the American Southwest.
boss_pitch: Hi Susan. As stated on the 40 warning signs you walked past, this is a geological formation, not art supplies. We are billing you for the helicopter rescue.

review_title: Bread was used as a weapon!
clue1: Beautiful architecture, but the locals are legally required to carry large, crusty loaves of bread and hit you with them if you walk too slowly.
clue2: The hills are so steep, my car rolled backward and crashed into a cable car. Extremely poor civil planning.
clue3: Went to see the Golden Gate, but it's painted red and made of steel. Not gold at all! False advertising.
clue4: A famous California city that is half bay-area and half sourdough loaf.
boss_pitch: Dear customer. We apologize that our legendary sourdough was used as a blunt instrument. However, we cannot control the local bakers, and please use your handbrake next time.

clue1: Extremely drafty. There are holes everywhere, it doesn't block the wind at all.
clue2: You'd think the most famous structure in Paris would be a bit more functional for the price.
clue3: Tried to dry off after my shower with it, but it's made of wrought iron and completely non-absorbent.
boss_pitch: Monsieur, if you are using 10,000 tons of 19th-century iron to dry your hair, you have significantly bigger problems than a slight draft.

clue1: Avoid at all costs. The entire city is infested with tiny, annoying insects that constantly try to sell you miniature Eiffel Towers.
clue2: The cafes are nice, but the bugs speak French and refuse to serve you if your pronunciation is slightly off.
clue3: I thought it was the City of Light, but it's actually the City of parasitic bloodsucking creepy-crawlies.
clue4: The French capital infested with tiny, blood-sucking creepy crawlies.
boss_pitch: Merci pour votre review. The 'insects' you refer to are street vendors. As for the pronunciation, we suggest you practice your accent before commenting on our hospitality.
